exposure: duration of active second stage of labor
prolonged active second stage of labor beyond 45 min
instrumental vaginal delivery only for failure to progress before 45 min of pushing
outcome: Transfer to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: Women with vaginal delivery, a term singleton cephalic fetus, without history of cesarean section
finding: Extending the duration of active second stage of labor beyond 45 minutes does not appear to be associated with increased adverse outcomes for mother or baby, although instrumental delivery rates were higher.
